standard_pricing_rules: List prices are the standard prices and include VAT.
On-the-road charges (delivery, number plates, first registration fee) are a fixed GBP 895 on new vehicles and GBP 295 on used vehicles.

offers.title: Autumn Electric Bonus
offers.description: GBP 1,000 off the list price of any new Voltaire.

offers.title: Family Friendly Finance
offers.description: Representative 5.9% APR on new Nomad and Trekker with a 10% deposit over 48 months. Subject to status; finance is provided by a fictional lender.

offers.title: Free First Service
offers.description: First service free on any new vehicle.

offers.title: Used Car Warranty Upgrade
offers.description: Upgrade from 12 to 24 months warranty for GBP 150 on any used vehicle.

offers.title: Part-Exchange Valuation Bonus
offers.description: GBP 250 added to any confirmed part-exchange valuation when buying a new vehicle.
